# A public tokeniser: too public?

## Tokenisation

breaks up text in simple units, often understood as words.

Tokens are the currency of GenAI

Try [https://platform.openai.com/home](https://platform.openai.com/home) and test their tokeniser.

Requires registration and activity is logged.
